# Vendor Icon References

This folder contains a small, curated set of open source SVG icons used as
reference material for Paperclip Pal identity props.

These files are not runtime defaults and should not be pasted onto the pal
unchanged. Treat them as licensed shape studies for redrawing small flat props
in the project's own style.

## Included Sources

- `tabler-icons/selected/`
  - Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
  - License: MIT, copied at `tabler-icons/LICENSE`
  - Visual role: sturdy 24x24 outline icons with 2px strokes.

- `lucide/selected/`
  - Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
  - License: ISC, copied at `lucide/LICENSE`
  - Visual role: simple 24x24 outline icons with 2px strokes.

## Adoption Rules

- Keep only selected SVG files, not whole icon libraries.
- Preserve source licenses and notices when redistributing.
- Redraw or normalize before using as Paperclip Pal props.
- Match Paperclip Pal colors: body gray, brow/pupil dark brown, paper off-white.
- Avoid gradients, shadows, detailed fills, hands, feet, and full costumes.
- Prefer prop silhouettes that read at small size: terminal, receipt, clipboard,
  gauge, search, bug, browser tabs.
